# AudioInfo { #timetoalign.loader.AudioInfo }

```python
loader.AudioInfo(
    n_samples,
    sample_rate,
    channels,
    duration_seconds,
    format,
    subtype=None,
    bits_per_sample=None,
    source_path=None,
    extra=dict(),
)
```

Metadata for an audio file.

This dataclass holds all relevant information about an audio file
that is needed to create a DiscretePhysicalTimeline.

## Attributes {.doc-section .doc-section-attributes}

| Name             | Type                                                | Description                                                  |
|------------------|-----------------------------------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------|
| n_samples        | [int](`int`)                                        | Total number of samples in the file (frames).                |
| sample_rate      | [int](`int`)                                        | Sample rate in Hz (e.g., 44100, 48000).                      |
| channels         | [int](`int`)                                        | Number of audio channels (1=mono, 2=stereo).                 |
| duration_seconds | [float](`float`)                                    | Duration in seconds (computed from n_samples/sample_rate).   |
| format           | [str](`str`)                                        | Audio format/codec (e.g., "WAV", "FLAC", "MP3").             |
| subtype          | [str](`str`) \| None                                | Audio subtype/encoding (e.g., "PCM_16", "PCM_24", "VORBIS"). |
| bits_per_sample  | [int](`int`) \| None                                | Bit depth (e.g., 16, 24, 32). May be None for lossy formats. |
| source_path      | [Path](`pathlib.Path`) \| None                      | Path to the source file.                                     |
| extra            | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), [Any](`typing.Any`)\] | Additional format-specific metadata.                         |
